title: The Rooftop Recipe Leak
intro: Just before the rooftop movie started, the family's secret popcorn recipe was found pinned to the wrong projector screen.

suspects.name: Oskar
suspects.line: Recipes are my life. Nobody touches my notes.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I've been knitting by the railing all evening, dear.

suspects.name: Juno
suspects.line: I was busy blowing up beach balls the whole time!

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was sitting right next to the projector cable, promise.

suspects.name: Rafi
suspects.line: I only came up for the snacks, I swear.

clues.text: A pair of reading glasses was left hooked on the booth latch. The culprit wears reading glasses, which narrows the suspects considerably.
A knitted beanie snagged on the railing rules out anyone wearing one. The culprit was not the beanie wearer, so that hat is off the list.
A friendship bracelet was found tangled in the blanket pile. The culprit is not the one wearing friendship bracelets, so that bracelet owner is cleared.
A cloud of sunscreen-scented air hangs over the cooler. Whoever pinned the recipe does not smell of sunscreen, so that scent is ruled out.
